title: Leaf Fan Breeze

dialogue.speaker: willowby
dialogue.text: What if we use a leaf fan for gentle wind?

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Great idea! I’ll hold one side steady now!

dialogue.speaker: willowby
dialogue.text: Together we’ll create a breeze that moves leaves!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: The wind helps us clear the path fast!

dialogue.speaker: willowby
dialogue.text: Seeing teamwork, the forest feels brighter and calmer!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Our friends will thank us for this clever trick!
